mapper.select: select se.id as seasonId, se.display_title as seasonTitle, s.series_code as seriesCode, s.series_name as seriesName, d.id as divisionId, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, d.platform_code as platformName, d.game_mode as gameMode, d.game_mode as gameModeName, d.registration_mode as registrationMode, et.id as eventTeamId, et.team_name_snapshot as eventTeamName, et.team_name_snapshot as teamName, et.team_logo_file_id as teamLogoFileId, case when ep.is_captain = 1 then 'CAPTAIN' else 'PLAYER' end as roleInTeam, et.event_team_status as eventTeamStatus, d.division_status as divisionStatus, cs.id as currentStageId, cs.stage_name as currentStageName, cs.stage_type as stageType, cs.execution_status as stageExecutionStatus, st.group_scope_key as currentGroupId, dg.group_name as currentGroupName, st.rank_no as standingRank, st.standing_points as standingPoints, q.qualification_status as qualificationStatus, q.qualification_status as qualificationStatusName, (select m.id from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status not in ('FINISHED', 'CANCELLED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by m.match_time asc, m.id asc limit 1) as nextMatchId, (select m.match_time from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status not in ('FINISHED', 'CANCELLED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by m.match_time asc, m.id asc limit 1) as nextMatchTime, (select m.id from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status in ('FINISHED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by m.match_time desc, m.id desc limit 1) as latestMatchId, (select concat(m.home_score, ':', m.away_score) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status in ('FINISHED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by m.match_time desc, m.id desc limit 1) as latestMatchResult, case when d.format_snapshot_id is null then 1 else 0 end as legacyEvent, (select count(1) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id)) as matchCount, (select count(1) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status = 'FINISHED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id)) as finishedMatchCount, (select count(1) from basket_match m left join ( select s1.match_id, s1.submit_event_team_id, s1.submission_status from basket_match_submission s1 join ( select match_id, submit_event_team_id, max(version_no) as max_ver from basket_match_submission where is_delete = 0 group by match_id, submit_event_team_id ) lv on lv.match_id = s1.match_id and lv.submit_event_team_id = s1.submit_event_team_id and lv.max_ver = s1.version_no where s1.is_delete = 0 ) ps on ps.match_id = m.id and ps.submit_event_team_id = et.id where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status != 'CANCELLED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) and (ps.submission_status is null or ps.submission_status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED')) ) as pendingSubmissionCount from basket_event_player ep inner join basket_event_team et on et.id = ep.event_team_id and et.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_division d on d.id = et.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_season se on se.id = et.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join ( select ds.* from basket_division_stage ds inner join ( select division_id, max(stage_order) as max_order from basket_division_stage where is_delete = 0 and execution_status in ('RUNNING', 'RESULT_PENDING_CONFIRM', 'COMPLETED') group by division_id ) lo on lo.division_id = ds.division_id and lo.max_order = ds.stage_order where ds.is_delete = 0 ) cs on cs.division_id = d.id left join basket_standing st on st.is_delete = 0 and st.stage_id = cs.id and st.event_team_id = et.id and st.group_scope_key = ( select coalesce(min(st2.group_scope_key), 0) from basket_standing st2 where st2.is_delete = 0 and st2.stage_id = cs.id and st2.event_team_id = et.id ) left join basket_division_group dg on dg.id = st.group_scope_key and dg.is_delete = 0 and st.group_scope_key > 0 left join basket_division_stage_qualification q on q.is_delete = 0 and q.stage_id = cs.id and q.event_team_id = et.id and q.qualification_status in ('PREVIEW', 'CONFIRMED') where ep.is_delete = 0 and (ep.member_id = #{memberId} or ep.source_player_id = #{playerId}) group by et.id, ep.is_captain order by se.id desc, d.sort_order asc, et.id desc
